headline: Sensex slumps over 1,300 points as market reverses early gains amid profit-taking and global sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit-taking by investors following a strong four-week rally
Heavy drag from financial, banking, and metal stocks
Weak global market cues driving broader sell-off
Sharp jump in market volatility with India VIX rising nearly 8%
whatHappening: Sensex crashed over 1,300 points intraday, tumbling from opening highs
Nifty fell sharply below the key 25,400 level
Investors lost between ₹4 lakh crore and ₹5.64 trillion in market capitalization
S&P projected India's FY27 growth at 7% while highlighting inflation risks from El Nino
summary: Indian equity markets witnessed a severe intraday sell-off as the Sensex plunged over 1,300 points and Nifty dropped below 25,400. Profit-taking in banking and financial stocks after a multi-week rally erased early morning gains. Market capitalization fell by trillions as volatility surged alongside weak global signals.
